text: はいって　みる　かちは　あると　おもうがね

structure.jp: はいって　みる　かちは
structure.en: the worth of trying going in

structure.jp: あると　おもうがね

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と before おもう wraps up what is being thought. あると　おもう = 'I think there is'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form verb means doing something to see what it is like. はいって　みる = 'try going in'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: はいって　みる　かち
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. はいって　みる　かち = 'the worth of trying going in', that is, 'worth going in to see'.
